newsitem.title: USA: UC Television sells shrs, warrants.
newsitem.headline: UC Television sells shrs, warrants.

text.p: UC Television Network Corp said Friday it has sold about 66 percent of its outstanding shares and warrants representing 9 percent of its shares for $16.2 million.
The shares and the warrants were sold at $0.55 per share in a private placement to U-C Holdings LLC, a newly formed entity sponsored by Willis Stein & Partners LP.
U-C Holdings also has entered into an equity protection agreement entitling it to maintain its 75 percent equity interest in the event of subsequent issuances of stock by the company.
